flavor: Follow my lead.
name: Agent Anti-Venom
text: Response: After Agent Anti-Venom enters play, discard cards from the top of your deck until you discard an ally that shares a TRAIT with him → put that ally into play.

flavor: It is my job to thread the needle between two worlds.
name: Codex
text: Response: After Codex is defeated during the player phase, discard the top card of your deck. If that card is a Venomized (black) card, return Codex to your hand.

flavor: Put me in coach!
name: Mania
text: Response: After Mania is defeated during the player phase, draw 1 card.

flavor: I was afraid I'd lose myself in this monster. I've never felt more found.
name: Red Goblin
text: Response: After a minion enters play, exhaust Red Goblin → deal 1 damage to that enemy.

flavor: Let me give you an insight into symbiotes... we're infinitely stronger with a host than without one.
name: Sleeper
text: Response: After Sleeper is defeated during the player phase, confuse the villain.

flavor: Together we're stronger. Faster. Better.
name: Venom
text: Venom gets +1 ATK for each Venomized (black) card tucked under it. Response: After you defeat a minion, tuck a card from your hand under here.

flavor: “Come and get a piece of this!” –Deadpool
name: Backed into a Corner
text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When you would take any amount of damage, prevent an amount of damage equal to your DEF and ATK combined.

flavor: “Does whatever a spider can, eh?” –Venom
name: Black Webbing
text: Hero Action: Choose a minion engaged with another player → stun and engage that enemy.

flavor: “You're afraid... afraid of who we really are...” –Venom
name: "Can't Escape Us!"
text: Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy. Exhaust a [[Symbiote]] card you control → deal an additional 3 damage to that enemy.

flavor: “No turning back now.” –Agent Venom
name: Dive into Danger
text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove threat from a scheme equal to your THW and DEF combined.

flavor: “Don't forget your green vegetables!” –Gwenpool
name: Feed the Hunger
text: Hero Action: Defeat a non-[[Elite]] minion engaged with you → heal damage from your identity equal to that enemy's total hit points.

flavor: “You aren't so scary little guy, are you?” –Black Cat
name: Forceful Bonding
text: Alter-Ego Action: Discard the top X cards of your deck. If any of those cards is a [[Symbiote]] or Venomized (black) card, change to your hero form.

flavor: “Now let's see what this suit can do.” –Agent Venom
name: Inner Strength
text: Hero Action (attack): Deal damage to an enemy equal to your ATK and THW combined.

flavor: “Not so tough, are you?” –Venom
name: Scared of the Dark
text: Max 1 per round. Hero Action: Remove a tough status card from an enemy → stun that enemy.

flavor: “Stay close team.” –Agent Anti-Venom
name: Stronger Together
text: Max 1 per round. Hero Action: Ready 2 friendly characters that share a TRAIT.

flavor: “Smashing is what Hulk does best!” –Hulk
name: Symbiotic Drop Kick
text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 4 damage to an enemy. If you paid for this card using only [physical] resources, stun that enemy and draw 1 card.

flavor: “You lose. And you're going to answer for what you've done.” –Captain America
name: Symbiotic For Justice!
text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme (4 threat instead, if you paid for this card using a [mental] resource).

name: Symbiotic Go All Out
text: Requirement ([energy]). (While paying for this card, spend the listed resources.) Hero Action (attack): Exhaust your hero → deal damage to an enemy equal to the total of your hero's THW, ATK, and DEF values.

flavor: “A hero isn't always the one who always wins. They're the one who always tries.” –Spider-Man
name: Symbiotic Multitasking
text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 2 threat form a scheme. If you paid for this card using a [mental] resource, remove 2 threat from a different scheme.

name: Symbiotic Not Today!
text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When your hero defends against an attack, it gets +2 DEF for that attack. If you take no damage from this attack, remove 2 threat from a scheme.

flavor: “Lots of tricks up these sleeves, ladies and gentlemen.” –Moon Girl
name: Symbiotic One By One
text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy. If this attack defeats that enemy, deal 2 damage to an enemy.

flavor: “You do know the front door is unlocked, right?” –Spider-Man
name: Symbiotic Perseverance
text: Hero Response: After you change form, give your hero a tough status card.

flavor: “Surprise!” –Star-Lord
name: Symbiotic Sneak Attack
text: Action: Choose an ally in your hand that shares a TRAIT with your identity → put that ally into play. If that ally is still in play at the end of the phase, discard it.

flavor:
“Um. He's not normally like that, right?"
"No... he's never like this.” –Ganke Lee and Miles Morales
name: In the Thick of It
text: Victory 0. When Defeated: Each player may search their deck and discard pile for an upgrade with the [[Symbiote]] trait and put it into play. (Shuffle.)

name: Gluttony
text: Max 1 per deck. Response: After you spend this card, ready your hero.

name: Symbiote Infusion
text: Max 2 per deck. Hero Interrupt: When you spend this card to play a [[Symbiote]] card, draw 1 card.

name: The Power of the Bond
text: Max 2 per deck. Double the number of resources this card generates while paying for a Venomized (black) card.

flavor: “I cannot stress enough how crucial it is that no one outside this room learn what we're working on.” –Liz Allan
name: Alchemax
text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Alchemax → add the topmost aspect card from your discard pile to your hand.

flavor: “I have many things that require my attention.” –Doctor Steven
name: Doctor Steven
text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Doctor Steven → reduce the cost of the next Venomized (black) or [[Symbiote]] card played this phase by 1.

name: Durable Physiology
text: Uses (2 klyntar counters). Hero Interrupt: When a minion would attack you, exhaust this card and remove 1 klyntar counter from it → reduce all damage dealt to you this round by 1.

name: First Contact
text:
Play under any players control. Max 1 per player.
Your hero gets +1 ATK, +1 THW, and +1 DEF.

name: Klyntar Tendrils
text: Uses (3 klyntar counters). Hero Action: Exhaust this card and remove 1 klyntar counter from it → choose to either deal 1 damage to an enemy or remove 1 threat from a scheme. Then, heal 1 damage from your identity.

flavor: “If we're gonna do this... I have to find my own way...” –Dylan Brock
name: Symbiotic Bond
text: Max 1 per player. Resource: Take 1 damage and exhaust this card → generate a [wild] resource.

name: Urban Camouflage
text: Max 1 per player. Hero Interrupt: When an enemy would attack you, take 1 damage and discard this card → give your hero a tough status card and confuse that enemy.

flavor: “You cannot just go around eating anybody you want...” –Eddie Brock
name: "You Are What You Eat"
text: Max 1 per player. Response: After you heal damage from your identity, exhaust this card → draw 1 card.

name: Flash Fire
text: Weakness. (Begins the game in your deck and is discarded into your discard pile.) Forced Response: After this card enters your hand, take 1 indirect damage. (You may discard this card from your hand at the end of the player phase like any other card.)

name: Sensory Overload
text: Weakness. (Begins the game in your deck and is discarded into your discard pile.) Forced Response: After this card enters your hand, place 1 threat on each scheme. (You may discard this card from your hand at the end of the player phase like any other card.)
